summary: Cyabra, Inc. filed an 8-K Item 1.01 reporting a securities purchase agreement for a ~$6 million offering of 1,175,090 common shares, pre-funded warrants, Series A warrants (exercisable at $0.50, 5-year term), and Series B warrants ($0.45, 12-month term). The sale to accredited investors closed July 10, 2026. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a structured equity financing with warrants requiring stockholder approval, not a special situation. The filing includes customary lock-up and registration provisions.
